newsitem.title: EGYPT: Gunmen kill two farmers in southern Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill two farmers in southern Egypt.

text.p: Unidentified gunmen shot dead two elderly farmers in southern Egypt on Wednesday, the interior ministry said.
Khalaf Hassan Ahmed, 60, and Mohammed Amin Abderrehim, 65, were killed as they rode donkeys in Qalandool village, near Mallawi town, about 260 km (160 miles) south of Cairo.
The ministry did not say who it suspected was behind the shooting but Mallawi has been a centre for the Moslem militant group al-Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group).

In 1992 the group launched a bloody campaign to overthrow the government and set up a strict Islamic state. Its low-level guerrilla war in southern Egypt has targeted mainly policemen and civilians it suspected of helping the security forces.
More than 1,000 people have been killed in political violence in Egypt since the campaign began.
